# Mobile Runtime Intelligence

This document summarizes the current mobile runtime source of truth. The exhaustive generated repository catalog remains in `docs/architecture/master-system-intelligence.md`.

## Active Mobile Runtimes

- `apps/mobile/merchant-app`: active Flutter merchant builder and store operations app.
- `apps/mobile/shopper-app`: reserved manifest-only shopper app root.
- `apps/mobile/operator-app`: reserved manifest-only operator app root.

## Merchant App Backend Contract

- Mobile authenticated commerce traffic goes to `BFF_BASE_URL` / `API_BASE_URL`, which must point to `services/mobile-bff`.
- `services/mobile-bff` accepts the merchant `lb_session`, signs gateway internal session headers, strips raw mobile credentials, and proxies allow-listed `/v1` traffic to `services/api-gateway`.
- Identity login/signup still starts at `IDENTITY_BASE_URL`.
- Storefront previews and public links use `STOREFRONT_BASE_URL`.

## Current Environment Defines

`apps/mobile/merchant-app/dart-defines/staging.json` and `production.json` contain only public build-time values:

- `BFF_BASE_URL`
- `API_BASE_URL`
- `IDENTITY_BASE_URL`
- `STOREFRONT_BASE_URL`
- `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID`
- `TURNSTILE_TOKEN`
- `ENVIRONMENT`

Do not add Supabase keys, Firebase config, service-role credentials, internal HMAC secrets, or provider secrets to mobile dart defines.

## Firebase/Supabase Runtime State

- No Flutter runtime Firebase or Supabase SDK dependency is active in `apps/mobile/merchant-app`.
- Native Firebase config files and Google Services Gradle plugin references have been removed from the merchant app.
- `legacy/firebase/` remains historical/platform-blocked specification only and must not be imported into active runtimes.

## P0 Mobile Foundation Evidence

- BFF Worker: `services/mobile-bff/src/index.ts`.
- Mobile config: `apps/mobile/merchant-app/lib/config/app_config.dart`.
- Auth session storage: `apps/mobile/merchant-app/lib/services/store_auth_service.dart`.
- Analytics gateway reads: `apps/mobile/merchant-app/lib/services/analytics_service.dart`.
- Subscription checkout: `apps/mobile/merchant-app/lib/screens/subscription/pricing_screen.dart`.
- CI mobile gates: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
- Execution ledger/status: `docs/mobile-migration-blueprint/CODEX_MOBILE_FOUNDATION_LEDGER.md` and `CODEX_MOBILE_FOUNDATION_STATUS.md`.

## Verification Expectations

For mobile-impacting changes, run:

```sh
flutter pub get
flutter analyze
flutter test
flutter build apk --debug --dart-define-from-file=dart-defines/staging.json
flutter build ios --debug --no-codesign --dart-define-from-file=dart-defines/staging.json
node scripts/validate-governance.mjs
```
